description: ActiveCampaign is a customer experience automation platform for email marketing, CRM, campaigns, contacts, and automations. Businesses use it to manage contacts, marketing workflows, campaigns, and sales pipelines.
summary: ActiveCampaign exposes an account-specific REST API, an account-specific GraphQL API, and a remote MCP server; the REST and GraphQL APIs use an `Api-Token` header, while the MCP server uses OAuth initiated from a private per-account MCP URL.
